name: Binding the Dreadnaught
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Have you ever seen Dreadnaught armor, champion? No, of course you haven't. You're still a  boy - a tyke. Let me tell you, it is glorious.

You're probably asking yourself what any of this has to do with you, right? I'll tell you what, scrub; I need Dark Iron scraps and I'm willing to pay to get my hands on as many as possible.

I need the scraps to put together sets of Dreadnaught for our champions. Bring me scraps and get paid.
narrative.objectives: Korfax at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 30 Dark Iron Scraps.
narrative.offerRewardText: This will do, for now. If you get more, you know where to find me.
narrative.requestItemsText:
<Korfax growls at you.>

What do you want? Directions? I can provide those...
